facts.fact: Voices, a communications source quoted by StackAdapt, says it has over one million members and is the largest marketplace for audio and voice over products and services in the world.
facts.quote: With over one million members, Voices is the largest marketplace for audio and voice over products and services in the world.

facts.fact: According to a cited podcast statistics source, 37% of Americans listen to podcasts monthly.
facts.quote: [37% of Americans](https://www.podcastinsights.com/podcast-statistics/) listen to podcasts monthly and 24% listen weekly

facts.fact: Voices, per its own statement, connects brands with voice actors in over 160 countries who speak in over 100 languages, accents, and dialects.
facts.quote: We connect brands and companies with voice actors in over 160 countries, who speak in over 100 languages, accents, and dialects.

facts.fact: Voices states that a fully-produced podcast ad can be 15-60 seconds long.
facts.quote: A fully-produced podcast ad can be 15-60 seconds long and are often more conversational and casual than a radio ad.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's interview notes that a typical Spotify audio ad is 30 seconds long.
facts.quote: If your ad is only 30 seconds long, like a typical Spotify ad, then you should focus on your key messaging and value points.

facts.fact: Voices states that human voice over versus a synthetic voice assistant voice has been shown in studies to increase brand recall for voice assistant ads.
facts.quote: For voice assistant advertisements in particular, the use of a human voice over a synthetic voice—like the built-in voice assistant voice—has also shown to increase brand recall.

facts.fact: Voices says audio ads are often more effective than traditional television and radio advertising, and certain studies show they increase brand recall.
facts.quote: Audio ads are often more effective than traditional advertising on television and radio, and certain studies have shown that they increase brand recall.

facts.fact: According to the page, podcast and music streaming listeners are opt-in, meaning people choose to consume that content, which gives the content an inherent trust.
facts.quote: because things like podcasts and music streaming have opt-in listeners, meaning people are choosing to consume this content, there is already an inherent trust built into the content.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that audio ad execution is critical to campaign success because ads must be inserted in the right places to reach the right people for a brand.
facts.quote: execution is critical for the success of your audio advertising campaign. You want to be able to trust that your audio ads are being inserted in the right places, reaching the right people for your brand.
